items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury. Earlier optimism from sources that he would play if no setbacks after feeling better Saturday.
items.why: Calf issue; DNP Friday but improved Saturday; McVay/sources confident.
items.implication: Start with confidence in 4:25 window; high WR upside vs LV.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected; reverse any stale Davante/Kyren beneficiary fades if any.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey to the locker room (thigh), listed questionable to return; later confirmed returned to game.
items.why: Thigh issue mid-game vs ATL; 49ers WR-depleted context.
items.implication: Monitor for limitation; still high-usage RB1 but injury risk elevated.
items.opportunity: If limited, backup RB snaps up; prior Levitan note on possible slot WR role amid WR outs.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially INACTIVE (quad). Rapoport earlier: unlikely after missing three games, not full participant; may have worked out but too early.
items.why: Quad strain; limited practice, sources pessimistic on readiness.
items.implication: Sit completely; Jets RB committee elevates without him vs MIA.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for remaining Jets RBs (Allen et al.); reverse any Hall-start plans.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT (ankle); Tyler Huntley expected to start again for Ravens vs Bengals. ETR Sunday summary lists as clear OUT after prior Q.
items.why: High ankle sprain; limited practice, downgraded Saturday/Sunday.
items.implication: Huntley start; Ravens pass game and rush attack volume shifts; fade Lamar-dependent stacks.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/carries for Zay Flowers, Derrick Henry, Mark Andrews in favorable spot vs CIN.

items.text: All ETR projections updated to reflect latest news (Lamar OUT, Puka GTD-opt, Breece GTD-pess, Jacobs/Coleman/Kirk/Mason/Dell IN, Saquon expected, Smith/Wicks OUT).
items.why: Direct incorporation of Sunday morning status summary.
items.implication: Use latest ETR numbers for start/sit/DFS; matches Schefter/Rap tightly.
items.opportunity: Implied opps for beneficiaries of OUTs/INs now baked in.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (hamstring) for Eagles Monday vs DAL; listed Q but trending positive after return to practice.
items.why: Hamstring; limited practice, sources optimistic for MNF return.
items.implication: Strong start candidate if confirmed active; efficiency strong in prior games; Dallas good RB matchup.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) for Monday vs DAL. Confirmed in ETR summary and Schefter/Rapoport reports.
items.why: Hamstring; did not practice, ruled out Saturday.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in PHI pass game; sit Smith.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for A.J. Brown, Dallas Goedert, George Pickens; more for Saquon if active.
items.conflict: Berry loved Smith pre-OUT based on volume.

items.text: Eagles WR Dontayvion Wicks OUT (ankle) alongside DeVonta Smith for MNF vs DAL.
items.implication: Further concentrates PHI targets; sit Wicks.
items.opportunity: Same beneficiaries as Smith OUT: Brown/Goedert/Pickens/Saquon snap/route share up.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated from exempt list and expected to play Sunday vs DET; ETR lists as IN.
items.why: Activated Saturday; ready for return after layoff.
items.implication: Workload question after long absence; monitor snaps vs DET tough run D.
items.opportunity: Potential lead back carries/red-zone if full go; handcuff value if limited.

items.text: Jonah Coleman (Broncos, activated) should be rostered in 100% of leagues; by end of year the Broncos RB you wish you had. Go fix that!
items.why: Prior production (13 touches/TD W2); Dobbins/Harvey inefficient; role expansion likely.
items.implication: Priority add for depth/handcuff/upside; 100% roster rate target.
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps vs ARI with Surtain inactive possibly helping offense.

items.text: Status of Lamar (ankle), Puka (calf), Breece (quad) crucial to Sunday DFS main slate; hoping early news. Sneaky important scratches: Brian Robinson, Jahwar Jordan, Tyler Warren, Emeka Egbuka.
items.why: High leverage for projections/ownership; non-obvious OUTs missed by some.
items.implication: Update all projections (done per later post); fade scratched; pivot on Lamar/Puka/Breece outcomes.
items.opportunity: Egbuka/Warren OUT opens TB/IND TE/WR roles; Robinson OUT boosts WAS RBs.

items.text: Rarely buy RB-as-WR hype, but given 49ers dire WR situation (Evans/Deebo OUT) and Kaelon Black presence, tempted to buy CMC lining up more in slot this week after his smile comment.
items.why: WR injuries force creative usage; CMC smile on slot question.
items.implication: Potential routes/targets boost beyond standard RB work; higher ceiling in PPR/DFS.
items.opportunity: Expanded two-way role amid 49ers WR outs; monitor actual snaps/routes.
items.conflict: Historical skepticism on RB-WR alignments rarely panning out.

items.text: LOVE A.J. Brown @ CHI (usage/matchup); back in real role, Bears good for yardage. Part of pass-catcher loves with volume/matchup themes.
items.why: Usage rebound + Bears defense allows yardage; elite spot.
items.implication: Strong WR start; top-10 overall consideration.
items.opportunity: High target share expected; further boosted by DeVonta/Wicks OUT.

items.text: LOVE Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE buffet); Lions D gift to opposing TEs (9 TE TDs allowed).
items.why: Matchup: Lions allow high TE production/TDs; Kraft volume.

items.text: LOVE volume RBs Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for big workloads in friendly matchups.
items.why: Consistent volume + defenses carved by RBs.

items.text: HATE Rome Odunze vs NE; 90% outside targets where Gonzalez likely shadows; low floor historically.
items.why: Tough CB shadow + outside alignment; poor recent floors.

items.text: HATE Josh Downs @ MIN (target-share/low-scoring offense) and Travis Kelce @ SEA (toughest pass D).
items.why: Downs: limited targets/offense; Kelce: elite SEA pass D.
items.implication: Sit both; look elsewhere at WR/TE.

items.text: HATE Josh Jacobs @ DET post-layoff; workload questions after long absence vs tough run D (RB18 rank).
items.why: Layoff rust + DET defense; uncertain snap share.
items.implication: Fade or bench despite activation; prefer other volume RBs.
items.conflict: Activated/expected to play per Schefter/ETR; possible full workload.
